fields.summary_ko.0: Seagate Technology (STX) has appreciated 452.7% since October 1, 2021, while revenue grew only 20.2% over the same period, with approximately 89.2% of the gain attributable to net margin expansion and multiple re-rating.
fields.summary_ko.1: Net margin expanded from 14.1% to 31.9%, explaining roughly half the stock appreciation, while the most recent quarter's net margin reached 41.6%, the highest in 10 years.
fields.summary_ko.2: To sustain the same rate of stock appreciation over the next five years would require annual revenue growth of 39.9%, compared to the trailing five-year annual revenue growth rate of 3.7%.
